messages:
olivia: Opening a small docs hotpatch to add the incident/status link and a short workaround for token-refresh flakiness we saw earlier. tagging reviewers.

jason: can you paste the status link and the exact copy you want in the doc? Legal asked we don't say 'server outage' in customer-facing docs.

olivia: status: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-11-token-refresh
Proposed copy: "Temporary mitigation: If you encounter intermittent 401s on long-lived streams after the incident, call the token refresh endpoint and then re-open your stream. See examples below. Engineering is deploying a permanent fix."

priya: looks fine. let's include minimal examples for JS and Python SDKs + curl so support can point to a snippet.

olivia: adding snippets. JS: `await client.auth.refreshToken()` then restart stream. Python: `client.auth.refresh_token()` (sync helper in python-sdk). curl for ops: 
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/refresh \
  -d '{"grant_type":"refresh_token","refresh_token":"REPLACE_ME"}'
```

jason: small nit: use 'incident' and 'service disruption' in the page header/body per comms template. Also add frontmatter tag `hotpatch: incident-2026-11` so we can filter.

olivia: done. opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6187 (includes md change, snippets, frontmatter tag). Preview: https://deploy-preview-6187--docs.redwood.example/incident-token-refresh-mitigation

ci-bot: build started for PR #6187 - job: ci/docs-preview.

priya: I loaded the preview quickly. code fences render but python snippet lacked language tag. small fix incoming.

olivia: pushed fix.

ci-bot: build failed for PR #6187 - error: docs-linter/frontmatter: missing required key `hotpatch` in frontmatter.

olivia: weird, I added `hotpatch` in the branch. looking.

jason: I think the frontmatter key name expected is `hotfixes` (plural) per the linter change last month. I'll update branch.

olivia: updated to `hotfixes: ["incident-2026-11-token-refresh"]` and pushed.

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR #6187 - preview: https://deploy-preview-6187--docs.redwood.example/incident-token-refresh-mitigation

jason: I'll review and approve in 20. can we merge before the nightly so support has it tomorrow?

priya: +1 expedited review. legal confirmed no additional review needed for this wording.

jason: approved. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: PR #6187 merged into main by olivia (docs).

olivia: thanks. I'll open a follow-up to cherry-pick to `release/2026-11` and add the support KB link. @support please add a short runbook note referencing the curl/js/python examples.

support: Will add runbook entry and paste snippets into internal KB. I'll link the KB in the cherry-pick PR.

statusbot: Incident 2026-11 token refresh — mitigated. Postmortem link: https://status.redwood.example/postmortem/2026-11-token-refresh

olivia: closing loop here. if anyone notices more broken links in the incident doc, please comment on PR #6187 and we'll patch similarly. thanks all. :rocket:
